$comment: Accepted high/critical advisories for scripts/audit-check.mjs (FND-5). Each entry needs id (GHSA), package, reason and the backlog item that removes it; reviewBy (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional and the gate fails once that date has passed. The gate audits the shipped libraries (dependencies) and Electron, which package.json lists as a devDependency but which is the runtime every user runs. Review at every release (docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md).

entries.title: fastify vulnerable to request body replacement via an async validation result collision
entries.reason: Remote-control (Stream Deck) server only, and only while Remote is on in Settings. It listens on the address the user chooses: 127.0.0.1 by default, often changed so a Stream Deck on another machine can reach it. Fixes exist only in fastify 5; upgrade planned.
